summary: Discover the power of Advanced Excel in Oil & Gas data analytics. Enroll in our training to boost your analytical capabilities and enhance your career prospects
lede: Oil and gas data analytics uses Excel to turn operational and financial records into structured analysis and reports. For analysts and operations professionals, the course covers cleaning and combining data with Power Query, building linked models and variance analysis, and creating PivotTable dashboards with automated reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who use Excel to manage operational, financial, and performance data across oil and gas workflows.
prerequisites: You should already be comfortable with Excel formulas, sorting and filtering, basic charts, cell references, and worksheet navigation. Prior experience with PivotTables, IF statements, and lookup functions is recommended for an intermediate-to-advanced pace. No programming background is required, although prior exposure to macros or VBA will help you move faster in the automation exercises. Participants should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed; the course is designed for hands-on work using provided oil and gas datasets, workbook templates, and guided practice files.
